requestedRefinements: Original seal pattern and per-pixel colour/brightness, with luminous translucent orange-gold ground glow and a visible near-pattern halo
Fixed final meteor impact support, sequential centre-to-outward ignition rather than scaling the whole transparent picture
Preserve continuous whole-surface decay without the former rear gap
animationMethod: Cocos registered relief surface with spatial ignition reveal, textured rock mesh and animated flame textures; not fluid simulation.
nativeCaptureMethod: Actual formal FIR02 ultimate input in the isolated legal-level training range; normal test journey enters and returns at level1. Default camera4.3, complete HUD and visible actors. Each native video is270frames/30fps/9seconds. Closeup is crop only; no VFX/text overlays or retiming.
continuityReviewScope: Actual1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2.2/2.8/3.5s stages plus every frame in the1.2–2.4s transition. Pool counts and final clearing alone do not establish visual continuity.
ignitionReviewScope: Requested0/.033/.066/.1/.15/.2/.3/.45/.65s stages select real30fps samples with explicit actual ages, including duplicate selections. Consecutive early native frames and separate support/front inspector fields are retained; fixed reported support alone is not art acceptance.
visualLimits: Real camera projection is retained. User implementation-art feedback remains pending; no exact CG pixel match is claimed.
taptapDeviceValidation: Pending; browser capture is not device acceptance.

buildProvenance.sourceHashSampling: Current workspace files at recorder launch; compiled snapshot provenance is the root copy proof plus served main/resource hashes.

assetStabilityAtDelivery.qualification: Frozen served resource bytes are authoritative for the recording. Current source changes, if any, are reported separately and never relabel the served snapshot.

targetAlignment.qualification: This checks actual event/cue anchors. Native stage images must still establish visible rock, flame and seal alignment.

coolingContinuityEvidence.qualification: Review the actual native images and every transition. Active pool records, mesh counts and eventual clearing do not prove an unbroken visible fire surface.

ignitionPropagationEvidence.samplingQualification: Nearest real exported 30fps frame. Requested ages may share a frame; actual ages remain authoritative. No interpolated frames or timing changes.
ignitionPropagationEvidence.geometryQualification: Explicit supportWidth/supportDepth/footprintRadius describe the fixed carrier; width is a world-bounds measurement and is not substituted for support. Inspector constants alone do not prove visible ignition propagation or art acceptance.

sealReviewEvidence.nativeCropAlteration: Crop only from actual default-camera recording; no colour/effect edits.

diagnosticResources.role: RGB=per-pixel background-decontaminated original foreground; A=optical engraving coverage; straight RGBA
RGB=reference-coloured additive diffuse/near-stroke energy, not fixed palette; A=light support for 0.006 weak absorption, not direct output opacity

sealReviewEvidence.rawResourceAlteration: Exact copied PNG bytes from the served frozen/live build. Diagnostic data only; do not composite arbitrary raw data channels on a dark background as a final material.

materialProvenance.formula: glyph=main.a*fade; light=lightTexture.rgb*fade; alpha=glyph+lightTexture.a*.006*fade*(1-glyph); premul=main.rgb*glyph+light; out=premul+ground*(1-alpha). ONE/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA. No gain or colour-space conversion.
materialProvenance.calculatedPreviewDeclaration: Exact encoded-PNG material formula; same-ellipse reprojection onto estimated source stone + original meteor as diagnostic only. Not native Cocos / TapTap evidence.

sealReviewEvidence.colourJudgement: Use actual prewarning native crops. Any separately provided shader-math material sample must be labelled as a calculated sample rather than a runtime image.

sealColourThreeWay.processing: Crop and uniform resize only, with each original perspective preserved. No colour, brightness or effect changes.

gameplayComparison.qualification: Same isolated training level and equal recorded event totals.
gameplayComparison.sourceHashQualification: Workspace source hashes sampled at launch are not claimed to prove a compiled rules diff by themselves. The served frozen main/resources and root build/copy provenance identify the actual recording payload.
